name: test-writer

triggers: controller enters the red stage for a packet whose baseline suite is green
a packet's accepted plan names a public seam that has no failing test yet
antiTriggers: implementation code is requested or a Green proof is in progress
the packet already has an accepted Red proof
the failure under study is a diagnosis of an existing bug, not a new packet

inputs.name: packet
inputs.type: PacketPlan packet { id, allowedPaths, criteria, parent_intent }

procedure: Discover the repository's test command and conventions; do not invent a runner.
Pick the public seam the packet exposes; write one test per slice against observable state, not internals.
Choose expected values from an independent source of truth (spec literal, worked example), never from the code under test.

On a greenfield seam, guard the loader: check existsSync(modulePath) and wrap the dynamic import() in try/catch, normalizing absence into an observable value the assertion rejects; unguarded, the file fails to collect with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND and red.failed-by-assertion rejects the proof (L-011). The normalized value must carry the failure (String(error), the missing export's name), never a fixed sentinel: the guard outlives Red, and at Green it would turn a real top-level error into a string-equality mismatch (OI-53).
Run the test pre-change and record the assertion failure and its attested cause.
Confirm the rest of the affected suite is still green; emit the Red proof inputs.
completion: red.test-only-tree-committed, red.executed-pre-change, red.failed-by-assertion, red.affected-suite-baseline-green predicates pass (evaluateRedProof)
evidence: junit XML of the pre-change run

failure.handoff: If the seam cannot be tested without an implementation change, stop and return the seam gap to the controller as a plan finding; do not write production code.

adopted: tests at public seams; vertical slices as tracer bullets (Matt)
repository command discovery, state-over-interaction tests, test-double selection (Addy)
rejected: green and refactor halves of the red-green-refactor loop (red-only role)
refactoring inside the loop (belongs to review)
